inputs.story: A group of friends has decided to try several different weight-loss diets and exercises to see who amongst them can lose the most weight in 3 months. Using only the clues below, match each person to their total number of pounds lost, and determine the diet type they used and their preferred type of exercise. Remember, as with all grid-based logic puzzles, no option in any category will ever be used more than once.
inputs.constraints:
1. Celia used the gluten-free diet.
2. The friend who lost 3 pounds used the low-fat diet.
3. Mandy lost 2 fewer pounds than Raymond.
4. Mandy lost 4 more pounds than Tom.
5. The dieter who used the vegan diet is either Mandy or the friend who lost 3 pounds.

pounds lost: 3; 5; 7; 9.
diets: dairy-free; gluten-free; low-fat; vegan.
names: Celia; Mandy; Raymond; Tom.

7	Mandy	vegan
9	Raymond	dairy-free
